description: Update the building envelope model to account for thermal bridging in window frames. In the '4StoreyBuilding' project, locate all windows on the Ground Floor (zones starting with 'G.'). Change their Frame Width to 0.21 feet and Frame Conductance to 2.2 Btu/h-ft2-F. Do not modify windows on the upper floors. After making the changes, run the full annual simulation and save the project.
